note: Hybrid dockyards. Merchant docks from Statbase 2025 DWT (UNCTAD/Clarksons ships-built series): 1 dock per 2 million dwt, and only if the tag delivered at least 0.8 million dwt. That is the commercial industrial base (CHI/KOR/JAP). Naval docks are Janes/IISS construction campuses, same 1-campus rule as mils. Mega-yards 2–4. Repair-only bases omitted. NavBase / Phoenix_jz fleet tonnage is an inventory cross-check, not a formula — it is why USA cannot be 0 while the Philippines is 1. Dual-use Chinese yards: merchant GT is the steel; naval campuses are extra PLAN slipways at those complexes. Do not use leftover CSV docks.
sources: UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport 2025 Table II.1: 2024 merchant GT shares China 54.57%, Korea 28.02%, Japan 12.56% (Clarksons)
Statbase Ships built by country of building, 2025 DWT (UNCTAD/Clarksons underlying): world 77.28M dwt, China 41.60, Korea 21.13, Japan 10.12
Janes Fighting Ships / IISS Military Balance: certified military construction yards and 2024–2026 procurement programs
NavBase (theworldwars.net, updated Jan 2025) and Phoenix_jz aggregate displacement 1 Jan 2025: fleet-tonnage ranking as drydock-need cross-check, not dock counts

USA.source: Janes: Newport News (CVN/SSN) 3, Electric Boat Groton 2, Ingalls Pascagoula 2, Bath Iron Works 1, NASSCO 1, Austal Mobile 1, Fincantieri Marinette 1. UNCTAD 0.04% merchant. Phoenix_jz ~4.5–7.3 Mt fleet is why this cannot be 0.

CHI.source: PLAN serial slipways at dual-use CSSC complexes: Jiangnan 3, Dalian 2, Hudong-Zhonghua 2, Huangpu 1, Wuchang 2, Bohai 2. Merchant DWT is extra steel, not a substitute for these halls.

KOR.source: Hanwha Ocean Geoje (KSS-III, KDX) 2, HD Hyundai Ulsan 2, HJ Shipbuilding Busan 1. Merchant DWT is the rest of Geoje/Ulsan.

JAP.source: MHI Nagasaki 2, JMU Kure 1, Kawasaki/MHI Kobe 1, JMU Yokohama 1. Mogami / Taigei serial.

SOV.source: Sevmash 2, Admiralty 1, Yantar 1, Amur 1, Zvezda 1. Yasen/Borei/Admiral Gorshkov. Merchant DWT is LNG/icebreakers, not these halls.

ENG.source: BAE Barrow 2 (Dreadnought/SSN), Govan/Scotstoun 1 (Type 26), Rosyth 1. Not Belfast.

FRA.source: Naval Group Cherbourg 1, Lorient 1, Chantiers de l'Atlantique/Saint-Nazaire 1, Toulon 1.

ITA.source: Fincantieri Muggiano/Riva Trigoso 2, Castellammare 1, Trieste 1. Cruise GT is not warship docks.

RAJ.source: MDL Mumbai, GRSE Kolkata, CSL Kochi, Hindustan Shipyard Visakhapatnam. P-15B / Kalvari / next carrier.

TUR.source: Istanbul Naval/Pendik, Gölcük, ADIK. MILGEM / Reis / amphibs serial (IISS).

SPR.source: Navantia Ferrol and San Fernando/Cádiz. Not Ceuta.

GER.source: TKMS Kiel (212/212CD) and Hamburg/Blohm+Voss. Cruise GT omitted.

FOR.source: CSBC naval + indigenous submarine program. Statbase merchant collapsed.

DPK.source: Sinpo and Nampo. UN Panel / IISS new-construction, not GT.

BRA.source: Itaguaí / Rio nuclear-sub and remnant surface.
